title: ADI Foundation and Zamanat partner to bring US$150mln in tokenized private credit, trade finance and Sukuk opportunities
summary: Partnership has an ambition to support up to US$150 million in tokenized assets

contentHtml:
ADI Foundation and Zamanat Advisors Ltd have signed MoU to explore opportunities in real-world asse tokenization, bringing together asset origination, financial structuring and institutional blockchain infrastructure. Image courtesy: ADI Foundation

Partnership has an ambition to support up to US$150 million in tokenized assets

Press Release

ABU DHABI, UAE - ADI Foundation, an Abu Dhabi-based organization building the digital infrastructure that empowers institutions, governments and businesses to lead the next generation of the global digital economy, and Zamanat Advisors Ltd, a Shariah-aligned orchestrator for tokenized investment products, have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore opportunities in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization, bringing together asset origination, financial structuring and institutional blockchain infrastructure.

Under the agreement, ADI Foundation will provide access to a pipeline of real-world asset opportunities and ADI Chain infrastructure, while Zamanat will lead credit analysis, due diligence, transaction structuring and investor distribution coordination. Together, the organizations will evaluate opportunities to develop investment products designed to meet institutional requirements, with ADI Chain supporting issuance, ownership records and settlement infrastructure, and regulated activities undertaken by appropriately authorized providers where required.

Initial areas of focus include maritime finance, SME credit, trade finance receivables and Sukuk, including Shariah-compliant structures. The parties expect the initial pilot to explore tokenized vessel financing including structures designed to provide periodic distributions to eligible investors. 

The framework also establishes an ambition to support up to of US$150 million in tokenized assets on ADI Chain, drawing on opportunities sourced by both organizations, subject to commercial viability and regulatory requirements.

Ramana Kumar, ADI Foundation’s President of Stablecoin Ecosystem, said:

“ADI is the ‘go-to’ chain for all institutional grade high-quality assets focused on bringing real economic activity and financing opportunities on-chain. Whether financing a vessel, extending credit to an SME or supporting trade, these are established markets with real demand for capital. Zamanat brings the credit, structuring and distribution expertise to help us translate those opportunities into investment products that institutions can evaluate and participate in.”

Umair Tariq, CEO of Zamanat Advisors Ltd, said:

“The global market we are building for Digital Shariah Assets needs a steady supply of assets that institutions can underwrite and a chain they trust to issue and settle them. This collaboration gives us both. ADI brings origination and ADI Chain, and we bring the credit analysis and structuring, with Shariah review on each Sukuk and Islamic structure, that turn an SME facility, a trade receivable or an underlying asset into a product an investment committee can approve.”

The agreement establishes a framework for the organizations to identify potential transactions, assess their commercial, credit and regulatory viability, and advance selected opportunities toward development and implementation.

The collaboration advances ADI Foundation’s broader strategy to establish ADI Chain as infrastructure for real-world economic activity helping institutions originate, manage and access tokenized assets.

 About ADI Foundation:

The ADI Foundation is an institutional gateway enabling public and private sector organizations to adopt blockchain technology through purpose-built, policy-aligned infrastructure, expanding financial access for underserved communities globally.

Central to ADI’s mission to connect one billion people and institutions to the digital economy by 2030 is ADI Chain, the first institutional blockchain for stablecoins and real-world assets in the MENA region. ADI Chain acts as settlement infrastructure for a dirham-backed stablecoin, DDSC, initiated by IHC, Sirius International Holding and First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) and licensed by the UAE Central Bank.

ADI collaborates with leading global institutions including BlackRock, Mastercard, M-Pesa, Visa, and Franklin Templeton and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), the world’s first jurisdiction with a bespoke digital asset framework. ADI was founded by Sirius International Holding, the technology-focused subsidiary of International Holding Company.

About Zamanat

Zamanat is building the global market for Digital Shariah Assets. The company connects asset originators with global capital through investment structuring, Shariah expertise, regulated partner routes, tokenization and distribution across traditional and digital channels.

Zamanat also sponsors and develops institutional investment products through appropriately licensed partners. Each product follows its own legal and regulatory framework and, where presented as Shariah-aligned, its own product-specific Shariah review and governance process.
